reason: I already apply to campaigns on Influish and barter offers from cafes land in my DMs every week, so I don't see why I'd pay for another app. I might connect Instagram while it's free to see what it shows me, but I wouldn't commit to the ₹499 pass.
objection: It's a beta with a small team. If it doesn't bring me paid deals my DMs and Influish don't already bring, then it's just one more app to check, and barter isn't worth paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If my free first collab through Mitra turned out to be properly paid, more than what barter usually gets me, and the café coupon counts actually got my rate raised the next time.
